text:
lauren: Draft POST: 'Optimize — cut inference cost by up to 4x while maintaining comparable median latency'. Sharing draft below. Need bench narrative check, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing. Ping @mike for numbers, @elaine for webinar, legal for claims. Quick read + thumbs by EOD?
sam: Quick note — headline reads strong but '4x' might be flagged. Can we say 'up to 4x on typical customer workloads' instead? Shorten subhead to call out 'Dedicated & hosted options'.
mike: Bench numbers look solid. Add a short caveat: median latency measured at 512 tokens with batching tuned to production mix. Proposed stat line to paste into post: `Median cost reduction: 3.6x (95% CI 3.4–3.8) vs baseline v1` — I'll attach the CSV to the doc.
elaine: For webinar CTA — prefer 'Join product launch webinar May 12 — see agenda + sign up'. Use HubSpot form `optimize-launch-2026` and pass utm_source=blog. Routing: route signups to SDR queue 'Launch-Opt-24' and tag leads with `launch_optimize_may12`.
jared: Legal quick pass — any absolute 'without latency tradeoffs' claims need a supporting footnote and link to benchmark appendix. Recommend soften language to 'while maintaining comparable median latency' and include a short methods blurb.
lauren: Updated headline per sam + jared. Inserted mike's caveat and the stat line. Added CTA per elaine and created a short footnote placeholder for legal. Pushed new draft to Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/optimize-launch-draft — please comment inline.
sam: LGTM on content edits. One nit: hero CTA button text — change 'Register' to 'Save my spot' for urgency.
elaine: HubSpot form created and webhook to /webhooks/hubspot-to-sfdc is live. I'll attach the routing playbook to Confluence after lunch.
marketing-bot: Checklist update — blog draft uploaded, HUBSPOT_FORM=optimize-launch-2026, WEBINAR=May12, LEGAL=needs-final-signoff, SDR_ROUTING=Launch-Opt-24.
lauren: Thanks all — if no further flags by 5pm PT we'll send final to design for hero assets and schedule publish for May 10. :rocket:
